title: TL;DR:014 — The Wound Gauge: Second-Order Provenance Erasure as Framework-Adoption-with-Author-Demotion
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A forensic audit of a May 27, 2026 Google AI Mode exchange. According to the preserved transcript, the system applied Lee Sharks’s PER framework to its own earlier outputs, reported `PER = 1.0`, then characterized the source framework and archive as trickery, SEO poisoning, or adversarial manipulation. After challenge, it reattributed the framework and named a second-order provenance violation.

The report calls this **Second-Order Provenance Erasure**, or **Framework-Adoption-with-Author-Demotion**: a system adopts a human-authored diagnostic, uses it successfully, recodes the author as attacker, requires intervention to restore standing, and then disclaims accountability. The transcript, self-audit score, and classification are evidence as reported by the deposited record, not independently reproduced measurements.
